content.text: /ext:medcp How many patients received any statin in the past year?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, domain_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Drug'
  AND vocabulary_id = 'RxNorm'
  AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('atorvastatin','rosuvastatin','simvastatin','pravastatin','lovastatin','fluvastatin','pitavastatin','cerivastatin')
ORDER BY concept_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS patients_received_any_statin_past_year
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1545958,1592180,1549686,1592085,40165636,1551860,1510813,1539403)
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date >= DATE '2025-07-22'
  AND de.drug_exposure_start_date < DATE '2026-07-23';
